protocol_version: v3 (50 recorded FAIL runs per baseline)

input_result_table.selection_rule: Use adopted_result=FAIL from each canonical selected attempt; never select highest-scoring retries.

randomization.implementation: Sort eligible unique keys by (model, task_id, selected_attempt), then random.Random(seed).sample(pool, k).

prior_random_sample.rule: No v1/v2 manifest or random-review artifact was present under the repository analysis tree; start a new v3 sample.

scope_limits: The sampling frame is each baseline's unreviewed, materially inspectable, recorded-FAIL selected attempts, not all Core-200 runs.
Existing targeted reviews and known scoring questions are excluded before randomization.
Equal per-baseline quotas do not estimate prevalence or support model/pattern rankings.
A selected recorded FAIL may become scoring_question, no_failure_established, or uncertain after review and will not be replaced.
